title: 文字整理台
description: 保留原文的文本清理台：整理空白、合并 PDF 断行、统一列表，预览后复制或下载。

flows: Three presets: whitespace 56→38 chars; PDF 9→7 lines; bullets normalize while numbered lines preserved
Custom input and optional inner-space collapse
Apply output then undo restores original
Clear and undo restores exact original
v3 repeated input undo restores first input
Copy click successful UI feedback; OS clipboard contents not independently verified
TXT download event completed and browser download path returned
100001-character input retained, processing disabled with clear error
Integrator independently read downloaded TXT bytes; exact UTF-8 match to visible sample result
limits: Narrow/mobile layout implemented and CSS reviewed, not real-device tested; cloud browser viewport-resize API unavailable
PDF line joining heuristic, not semantic document parsing

copy_audit_v4.result: Removed privacy/local-processing reassurance, redundant result placeholder; sample output unchanged

changes: Neutral input canvas versus white emphasized result
Accent reserved selected tab and primary copy action

palette_v6.scope: 15 specified text/background pairs measured; not a complete WCAG audit; disabled controls excluded

interaction: 粘贴文字，选择整理方式，对照结果后复制；可细调、撤销和下载。
